_rationales.horizontalFlip: Leaf disease symptoms are left-right symmetric in nature; flipping doubles effective data without altering symptom appearance.
_rationales.rotation10: Handheld photos arrive at arbitrary orientations; small rotations mimic real capture variance.
_rationales.colorJitter: Applied AFTER photometric reference normalization; range widened to ~±0.3 to cover lot-to-lot illumination/processing drift (the white-background cut-out left the test blight lot ~30% brighter and ~20% less saturated than its training lots, which collapsed blight recall on it).

photometricReference._note: Per-image leaf brightness normalized (RGB scaled by gain so mean leaf Value = this reference), computed from the TRAINING blight lots (LB_C/D/E) -- train-only statistics, leak-safe. The white-background cut-out left the test blight lot ~30% brighter than its training lots (Value 0.44 vs 0.34); this neutralizes that lot-level illumination drift and is applied identically at train and eval. Saturation normalization intentionally omitted: leaf saturation carries no class signal in this excised dataset.

normalization._note: ImageNet statistics required by torchvision MobileNetV2 pretrained weights
